'''Wilson Tchorshel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Special Agent/Legends|Special Agent]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:TN" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|Work with me. Help me to stop the Empire from getting yet another weapon with which to destroy innocent people.|Wilson Tchorshel, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TN" />}}
Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Wilson Tchorshel was the immediate superior of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Carh'la Bastra]] and was stationed in [[Kaadara]], a [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG:TN" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> he worked with a Rebel spacer who had previously worked with Captain Bastra on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Tchorshel tasked an operative with retrieving four experimental droid modules dating back to the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. The objective of Tchorshel was to recreate a powerful [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|artificial intelligence]] technology that was lost over the years. In the meantime, the droid modules were also wanted by the agents of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Maximilian Vox]].<ref name="SWG:TN" /> The spacer found the positional awareness triangulator chip in a [[MSE-series|mouse droid]] used by the [[Skaak Tippers]] in their [[Skaak Tipper Hideout|hideout]].<ref name="SWG:ORDMTMD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Old Republic Droid Modules: The Mouse Droid|Naboo}}</ref> The decentralized autonomy chip was given by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Borvo]] after the spacer managed to compromise the security of [[Borvo's Vault]].<ref name="SWG:ORDMBBD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Old Republic Droid Modules: Borvo's Battle Droid" on Naboo</ref> The spacer recovered the strategy/tactics simulation chip after destroying a [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]] in the [[Stonewall Labs]] headquarters, thanks to the assistance of [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Zanier Hudmasse]].<ref name="SWG:ORDMTD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Old Republic Droid Modules: The Droideka" on Naboo</ref> Finally, the spacer retrieved the [[stochastic decision chip]] with the help of [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Nass]] by destroying a [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droid]] in possession of the [[Ultragungans|Ultragungan Militia]].<ref name="SWG:ORDMTGBD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Old Republic Droid Modules: The Gungan Battle Droid" on Naboo</ref> The operative was successful and was then awarded the [[Medal of Bothawui]] by Wilson Tchorshel. With the four modules reunited, Tchorshel quickly left Naboo in order to transfer the AI modules to a Rebel research center.<ref name="SWG:BtdmtWT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Bring the droid modules to Wilson Tchorshel|Naboo}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Wilson Tchorshel was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG:TN" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Wilson Tchorshel was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
